newsitem.title: USA: Interferon says Blech, others sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Interferon says Blech, others sell shares.

text.p: Interferon Sciences Inc Friday said that David Blech and related trusts and entities sold an aggregate of about four million shares of Interferon common stock.
A company spokesman was not available for further details on Blech.
In a statement, the company said the shares were placed by Sunrise Securities Corp primarily with five institutional investors.

The Edward A. Blech Charitable Remainder Trust, Freedom Charitable Remainder Trust, Frontier Charitable Remainder Trust, Sentinel Charitable Remainder Trust and the Blech Family Trust, trusts of which David Blech is the income beneficiary but not the trustee, sold an aggregate of about 2.3 million shares, including 430,000 shares sold by Sentinel Charitable Remainder Trust. Biotechnology Investment Group, LLC, an entity in which the Edward A. Blech Charitable Remainder Trust has an interest, sold an aggregate of 1.7 million shares of common stock that had been pledged to Citibank, N.A.

A company spokesman later said Blech and related entities had been a major shareholder and the four million shares were the bulk of their stake. Blech had been a passive investor in the company, the spokesman said.
